overview.en:
Explore retail locations, catalogs, customers, orders and payments through Square.

Review store, catalog, customer, order, and payment context together. Use a specific location and date range to keep operational summaries comparable.

Complete the connection or local-runtime setup described by this plugin before using service tools. Results depend on the tools exposed to your account; specify the target resource and report scope when starting a task.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Square 查看门店、商品、客户、订单和支付，协助零售运营。

结合门店、商品、客户、订单与支付信息查看零售经营情况，用明确的门店和时间范围保持统计口径一致。

使用服务工具前，按插件说明完成连接或本地运行环境配置。结果取决于账号可用工具；开始任务时请说明目标资源与报告范围。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize orders and payments for this store last week.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 汇总这家门店上周的订单与支付情况。

starterPrompts.en: Review this product's catalog information and related orders.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 查看这个商品的目录信息与相关订单。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an operations brief for the selected store.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为选定门店准备运营简报。
